newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS UNLEADED GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS UNLEADED GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Wednesday it will cut its retail prices for unleaded gasolines in the Netherlands by one cent per litre and of diesel by two cents per litre with effect from January 17.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, Shell said.
From Friday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations goes down to 2.10 guilders per litre.
The price of Euro regular unleaded falls to 2.05 guilders and the recommended price for diesel goes down to 1.528 guilders per litre.
Premium with lead substitute will remain unchanged at a price of 2.17 guilders per litre, Shell said.
